devops-modernization-ai-agents.title: DevOps Modernization: AI Agents, Intelligent Observability and Automation
devops-modernization-ai-agents.description:
The panelists share how AI is redefining DevOps and SRE practices by moving teams beyond reactive monitoring toward predictive, automated delivery and operations. They discuss integrating AI agents into CI/CD pipelines and feature management to enable intelligent rollouts and machine-speed remediation.

Olalekan Elesin is Engineering Director @HRS Group & AWS Machine Learning Hero. Patrick Debois is AI Product Engineer and AI Native Dev Advisor. Mallika Rao is Engineering Leader @Netflix. Martin Reynolds is Field CTO @Harness. Renato Losio is InfoQ Editor.
